page.layout: One page of text, the running head at the top, a centred closing passage with "AMEN." below, then a fleuron ornament. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: Orandus autem est nobis, & exo-andus DEus, ut furores Satanae ipse ompescat, & eorum, qui diffidia volunt in Ecclesia, conatus reprimat: At nos in veritate tueatur ac conservet, ac proinde benignus efficiat, ut in Christo Iesu simus omnes unum. AMEN.

page.notes: The first letter of "compescat" is hidden at the left edge of the scan, so the word is given as "ompescat". The printed page number at the top right is small and partly worn, so "391" is doubtful. The handwritten "362" in the top right corner is not printed and is left out. The fleuron below the text is an ornament and is not transcribed. Printed spellings kept as they stand: "ipse", "efficiat", "Christo", "simus", "Ecclesia", "veritate", "conservet" (printed with a long s, read as s). The line "exo-/andus" is hyphenated as printed.
